changelog.title: Community Tracker & Search Overhaul
changes: Added Community Song Tracker with 1,201 Juice WRLD songs across DRFL, OUT, GBGR, and WOD eras
Added Live Sync Status indicators (🟢 Synced with direct LRC player vs ⚪ Not Yet Synced)
Added Full Lyrics Search engine with live line preview & keyword highlighting
Added Song Aliases support with personal custom nicknames saved in browser
Added 1-click 'Suggest Alternative Name' contribution via GitHub Issues
Added Crypto Donation support with 1-click address copy and QR codes (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC)
Added 'NEW' badges and '⭐ Recently Added' filter button
